name: zoom
description: Reads Zoom users, meetings, webinars, and bounded module-specific data through the Zoom REST API; includes approval-gated clinical-note status updates.

risk.read: external Zoom API read of user, meeting, webinar, Quality of Service, AI Companion, My Notes, and healthcare clinical-note data
risk.write: typed Zoom reverse ETL mutation of a healthcare clinical-note completion status
risk.approval: reverse ETL writes require plan, preview, explicit approval, and execute; read-only commands require none
